_comment: 20 invented entries. No real names, projects, places, credentials or personal facts. This is the single source of truth for demo/memory.sqlite.

entries.title: Northstar deploy window
entries.content: The Northstar service deploys every Tuesday at 09:00 UTC and freezes on the first Monday of each month for key rotation. Ben owns the rotation.

entries.title: Lumen project convention
entries.content: In the Lumen project, every database migration must be reversible in one command before it is merged.

entries.title: Ada preference
entries.content: Ada prefers concise status updates with blockers first and no progress narration.

entries.title: Ferry build limit
entries.content: The Ferry mobile build must stay under 40 MB because the target region has expensive mobile data.

entries.title: Orchard API rule
entries.content: The Orchard API treats a missing tenant id as an error rather than a default; there is no implicit workspace.

entries.title: Beacon review cadence
entries.content: Beacon design reviews happen on alternating Thursdays; skip the week of a public holiday.

entries.title: Marble data retention
entries.content: Marble keeps evaluation logs for 30 days and deletes raw prompts at 7 days; both are configurable.

entries.title: Quill writing rule
entries.content: Quill release notes never use the word revolutionary; the team considers it a warning sign.

entries.title: Sparrow test command
entries.content: Sparrow's full regression suite is `make verify`; the fast subset is `make verify-fast` and skips network tests.

entries.title: Cedar ownership
entries.content: Cedar's billing module is owned by two people; a single-owner change is not accepted in review.

entries.title: Pine offline mode
entries.content: Pine must remain fully functional for 72 hours without network access; sync resumes when connectivity returns.

entries.title: Drift release rule
entries.content: Drift never ships on a Friday; the cutoff is Thursday 15:00 UTC.

entries.title: Harbor archive
entries.content: Harbor archives old projects once a year into a read-only vault; nothing is deleted.

entries.title: Tide documentation language
entries.content: Tide documentation is written in British English; the API examples are language-neutral.

entries.title: Lighthouse lens interval
entries.content: The harbour lighthouse in the fictional town of Greyhaven rotates its lens every eight seconds.

entries.title: Aster backup cadence
entries.content: Aster backs up its fictional archive every third day, never on the first of the month.

entries.title: Willow naming
entries.content: Willow names test environments after trees, not after people.

entries.title: Kestrel review note
entries.content: Kestrel's reviewer asked for one diagram per design doc; nobody has confirmed this is a permanent rule.

entries.title: Fictional island rule
entries.content: On the fictional island of Morrow, all doors face east; this detail belongs to a story, not to a project.

entries.title: Old Ferry deadline
entries.content: A past Ferry deadline that was superseded and soft-deleted; restore is available but pointless here.
